nodes.label: src_care_areas
nodes.raw_sql:
-- Source model: src_care_areas
-- Note: After editing query logic, run dbt run --full-refresh
{{
    config(
        materialized='streaming_table',
        distributed_by={'columns': ['care_area_id'], 'buckets': 1},
        with={
            'changelog.mode': 'append',
            'kafka.cleanup-policy': 'delete',
            'scan.bounded.mode': 'unbounded',
            'scan.startup.mode': 'earliest-offset',
            'value.format': 'avro-registry'
        }
    )
}}

SELECT
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.care_area_id, after.care_area_id), 'UNKNOWN') AS care_area_id,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.name, after.name), '') AS name,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.facility_type, after.facility_type), 'WARD') AS facility_type,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.center_lat, after.center_lat), 41.8781) AS center_lat,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.center_lng, after.center_lng), -87.6298) AS center_lng,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.radius_meters, after.radius_meters), 500.0) AS radius_meters,
    `$rowtime` AS event_ts
FROM {{ source('cdc', 'care_areas') }}
WHERE op != 'd'

SELECT

    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.patient_id, after.patient_id), 'UNKNOWN') AS patient_id,

    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.battery_pct, after.battery_pct), 100) AS battery_pct,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.button_pressed, after.button_pressed), false) AS button_pressed,
    `$rowtime` AS event_ts
FROM {{ source('cdc', 'telemetry_events') }}
WHERE op != 'd'

nodes.label: fct_prescription_drift
nodes.raw_sql:
-- Fact model: fct_prescription_drift
-- Compares actual patient telemetry vs doctor prescription limits
-- Note: After editing query logic, run dbt run --full-refresh
{{
    config(
        materialized='streaming_table',
        distributed_by={'columns': ['patient_id'], 'buckets': 1},
        with={
            'changelog.mode': 'append',
            'kafka.cleanup-policy': 'delete',
            'scan.bounded.mode': 'unbounded',
            'scan.startup.mode': 'earliest-offset',
            'value.format': 'avro-registry'
        }
    )
}}

SELECT
    t.event_id,
    t.patient_id,
    t.device_id,
    t.heart_rate,
    t.spo2,
    p.prescription_id,
    p.min_threshold AS target_hr_min,
    p.max_threshold AS target_hr_max,
    CASE
        WHEN t.heart_rate > p.max_threshold THEN 'HIGH_HEART_RATE'
        WHEN t.heart_rate < p.min_threshold THEN 'LOW_HEART_RATE'
        WHEN t.spo2 < 92.0 THEN 'LOW_SPO2'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS drift_status,
    t.event_ts
FROM {{ ref('src_telemetry_events') }} AS t
JOIN {{ ref('dim_prescriptions') }} AS p
    ON t.patient_id = p.patient_id
WHERE p.target_metric = 'HEART_RATE'
  AND (t.heart_rate > p.max_threshold OR t.heart_rate < p.min_threshold OR t.spo2 < 92.0)

nodes.label: fct_emergency_button_routing
nodes.raw_sql:
-- Fact model: fct_emergency_button_routing (CEP)
-- Detects rapid repeated patient emergency button presses (2 or more within 5 minutes)
-- Note: After editing query logic, run dbt run --full-refresh
{{
    config(
        materialized='streaming_table',
        distributed_by={'columns': ['patient_id'], 'buckets': 1},
        with={
            'changelog.mode': 'append',
            'kafka.cleanup-policy': 'delete',
            'scan.bounded.mode': 'unbounded',
            'scan.startup.mode': 'earliest-offset',
            'value.format': 'avro-registry'
        }
    )
}}

SELECT
    patient_id,
    first_event_id,
    trigger_event_id,
    press_count,
    match_ts AS event_ts
FROM {{ ref('src_telemetry_events') }}
    MATCH_RECOGNIZE (
        PARTITION BY patient_id
        ORDER BY event_ts
        MEASURES
            A.event_id AS first_event_id,
            B.event_id AS trigger_event_id,
            2 AS press_count,
            B.event_ts AS match_ts
        ONE ROW PER MATCH
        AFTER MATCH SKIP TO NEXT ROW
        PATTERN (A B)
        WITHIN INTERVAL '5' MINUTE
        DEFINE
            A AS A.button_pressed = true,
            B AS B.button_pressed = true
    )

nodes.label: fct_vital_anomaly_streak
nodes.raw_sql:
-- Fact model: fct_vital_anomaly_streak (CEP)
-- Detects 3 consecutive abnormal vital readings (HR > 115 bpm or SpO2 < 91%) within 15 minutes
-- Note: After editing query logic, run dbt run --full-refresh
{{
    config(
        materialized='streaming_table',
        distributed_by={'columns': ['patient_id'], 'buckets': 1},
        with={
            'changelog.mode': 'append',
            'kafka.cleanup-policy': 'delete',
            'scan.bounded.mode': 'unbounded',
            'scan.startup.mode': 'earliest-offset',
            'value.format': 'avro-registry'
        }
    )
}}

SELECT
    patient_id,
    first_event_id,
    trigger_event_id,
    avg_hr_streak,
    min_spo2_streak,
    match_ts AS event_ts
FROM {{ ref('src_telemetry_events') }}
    MATCH_RECOGNIZE (
        PARTITION BY patient_id
        ORDER BY event_ts
        MEASURES
            A.event_id AS first_event_id,
            C.event_id AS trigger_event_id,
            (A.heart_rate + B.heart_rate + C.heart_rate) / 3.0 AS avg_hr_streak,
            LEAST(A.spo2, B.spo2, C.spo2) AS min_spo2_streak,
            C.event_ts AS match_ts
        ONE ROW PER MATCH
        AFTER MATCH SKIP TO NEXT ROW
        PATTERN (A B C)
        WITHIN INTERVAL '15' MINUTE
        DEFINE
            A AS (A.heart_rate > 115 OR A.spo2 < 91.0),
            B AS (B.heart_rate > 115 OR B.spo2 < 91.0),
            C AS (C.heart_rate > 115 OR C.spo2 < 91.0)
    )

nodes.label: fct_geofence_alerts
nodes.raw_sql:
-- Fact model: fct_geofence_alerts
-- Detects telemetry events reporting coordinates outside assigned care area radius
-- Note: After editing query logic, run dbt run --full-refresh
{{
    config(
        materialized='streaming_table',
        distributed_by={'columns': ['patient_id'], 'buckets': 1},
        with={
            'changelog.mode': 'append',
            'kafka.cleanup-policy': 'delete',
            'scan.bounded.mode': 'unbounded',
            'scan.startup.mode': 'earliest-offset',
            'value.format': 'avro-registry'
        }
    )
}}

SELECT
    t.event_id,
    t.patient_id,
    t.device_id,
    t.lat AS current_lat,
    t.lng AS current_lng,
    a.care_area_id,
    c.center_lat,
    c.center_lng,
    c.radius_meters,
    t.event_ts
FROM {{ ref('src_telemetry_events') }} AS t
JOIN {{ ref('src_device_assignments') }} AS a
    ON t.patient_id = a.patient_id AND t.device_id = a.device_id
JOIN {{ ref('src_care_areas') }} AS c
    ON a.care_area_id = c.care_area_id
WHERE ABS(t.lat - c.center_lat) > 0.005 OR ABS(t.lng - c.center_lng) > 0.005
